newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian rebels dynamite main oil pipeline.
newsitem.headline: Colombian rebels dynamite main oil pipeline.

text.p: Leftist guerrillas dynamited Colombia's main oil pipeline and caused the spillage of at least 5,000 barrels of crude, a spokesman for the state-run oil company Ecopetrol said on Tuesday.

The attack took place in eastern Arauca province on Monday along the 490-mile (780-km) pipeline that pumps 200,000 barrels a day from Cano Limon to the Caribbean coast oil terminal at Covenas, the spokesman said.
The Ecopetrol spokesman said pumping operations were resumed on Tuesday afternoon.
It is the 19th time guerrillas have blasted the pipeline with dynamite this year. Last year it was blasted 47 times, causing the loss of more than 105,000 barrels of crude and $9.3 million in damage.
